THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Butterfinger Peanut-Butter Protein Creami

Subtle PB2 peanut base with Butterfinger crunch. About 380 calories and 44g protein for the whole finished pint.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME10 min active + 24 hr freeze
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~380 cal | ~44g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: The nutrition estimate is for one entire finished pint, not one scoop.

Ingredients

SHARED BASE — ONE PINT

  • 1 cup Fairlife 2% ultra-filtered milk
  • 2 tbsp monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener
  • 1 serving unflavored whey isolate
  • 1/8 tsp guar gum
  • Pinch of salt

BLEND BEFORE FREEZING

  • 1 tbsp PB2 powder

AFTER FIRST SPIN

  • 10g Butterfinger baking bits

TOP AFTER SCOOPING

  • 10g more Butterfinger baking bits

Allergens: milk, peanuts, soy. Verify allergens and nutrition against your exact milk, whey, candy or cereal, and topping labels.

Subtle PB2 peanut base with Butterfinger crunch. Inspired by a Crumbl cookie flavor; this independent protein ice-cream build is not an official Crumbl recipe. The peanut base is gentle and the candy adds crunch; it does not claim to taste identical to the frosted cookie.

Method

  1. 1.BLEND. Blend the shared base with 1 tbsp PB2 powder until fully smooth. These amounts make one pint.
  2. 2.FREEZE. Pour into one Creami pint below the max-fill line. Freeze upright and level for 24 hours.
  3. 3.SPIN. Rest about five minutes, then run Regular Ice Cream. If powdery, run a no-liquid Respin before mix-ins.
  4. 4.MIX-IN. Add 10g Butterfinger baking bits to the spun pint and run Mix-In.
  5. 5.FINISH. Scoop and top with 10g more Butterfinger baking bits. Serve immediately.

Keys to success

  • Each flavor uses its own pint; do not combine the three flavor additions into one base.
  • Use a no-liquid Respin only if the first spin is powdery; keep crunchy toppings for the finish.

Storage and reheating

Store: Freeze the unspun base upright and level; add mix-ins and toppings when ready to eat.

Reheat: Do not heat. If refrozen after spinning, re-spin per machine guidance and refresh crunchy toppings.

Lasts: Best texture when spun within two weeks.

Estimated nutrition

~380 cal | ~44g protein per 1 complete finished Creami pint.

Approximate whole-pint estimate: 240 calories and 40g protein in the shared base, 30 calories and 3g protein from PB2, and about 107 calories and 1g protein from 20g Butterfinger bits. Rounded to 380 calories and 44g protein; exact labels vary.
